messages:
Flint: morning pic drop — discovered a sunbeam + reflective sticker and turned it into a one-cat disco. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F00000/flint_disco.jpg :sun_with_face: :cat2:

Nora: omg glitter rave in my heart. is the sticker alive? :eyes:

Liam: silent disco but make it feline. headphones not included. :headphones:

Riley: quick poll  name this move: 1) Sunbeam Shuffle  2) Sticker Shimmy

Nora: `/:one:` Sunbeam Shuffle all the way

Liam: `/:two:` Sticker Shimmy has better groove

PollBot: Poll created: "Name Flint's dance move" Options: Sunbeam Shuffle / Sticker Shimmy — Current: Sunbeam Shuffle 1, Sticker Shimmy 1

Emi: uploading a short boop-vid — he flops mid-shim and a leaf photobombs. 4/5 would pet, would not share snack.

Flint: *not a dog* (weird unimpressed meow) :cat:

Riley: leaf = backup dancer. ceremony at lunch for naming rights.

Nora: can we get a tiny disco ball for the office cat? proposal filed. :tophat:

Liam: drafting budget line: "Small morale expense: 1 cat disco ball" — will cc finance. :memo:

Emi: add snacks for humans and a separate tuna stipend for Flint. fairness. :plate_with_cutlery:

Riley: DM me if you want the high-res pic for your wallpaper. glitter included. :sparkles:
